name: Guangdong Highsun Meida New Materials Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Highsun Meida New Materials Co., Ltd. engages in the production, spinning, knitting, dyeing, and sales of nylon 6 chips in China.It provides regular, copolyimide, high-reactive PA6, and modified nylon 6 chips; and regular fiber, sustainable products, big creatures, functional products, temperature and humidity control, cool, and featured differentiated products. The company was formerly known as Guangdong Xinhui Meida Nylon Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Guangdong Highsun Meida New Materials Co., Ltd. in June 2024. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Jiangmen, China.
